abilities.effect: The birds screech in panic, dealing 3d12+20 sonic damage to all creatures in the garden (DC 44 basic Fortitude save). On a failure, the creature becomes stunned 1 (stunned 3 on a critical failure). The trap then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Panic!

traits.name: Sonic
traits.text: An effect with the sonic trait functions only if it makes sound, meaning it has no effect in an area of silence or in a vacuum. This is different from an auditory spell, which is effective only if the target can hear it. A sonic effect might deal sonic damage. A creature with this trait has a magical connection to powerful sound.

abilities.trigger: An undead or a creature with negative healing enters the garden

hazard.description: Hundreds of panicked whippoorwills swarm through the area.
hazard.disable: DC 43 Nature (master) to calm the birds, DC 45 Occultism (master) to alter your aura, or DC 45 Performance (master) to imitate the living
hazard.name: Avian Rage
hazard.reset: The trap deactivates and resets if 1 minute passes without any undead or creatures with negative healing in the garden.
hazard.routine: (1 action) The birds swarm wildly through the garden, pecking and slashing at all undead creatures and creatures with negative healing in the garden, dealing 3d10+20 slashing damage and 1d10 persistent bleed damage (DC 44 basic Reflex save).

traits.name: Rare
traits.text: This rarity indicates that a rules element is very difficult to find in the game world. A rare feat, spell, item or the like is available to players only if the GM decides to include it in the game, typically through discovery during play. Creatures with this trait are rare. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creatures is increased by 5.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.
